# Ignore Visual Studio user-specific files
*.user
*.suo
*.vscode/
*.vs/

# Ignore build artifacts
bin/
obj/

# Ignore package dependencies
packages/
!packages/repositories.config

# Ignore .NET Core generated files
project.lock.json
project.assets.json

# Ignore logs and database files
*.log
*.tlog

# Ignore temporary files
*.tmp
*.cache
*.csproj.user

# Ignore ASP.NET Razor specific files
wwwroot/node_modules/
wwwroot/lib/

# Ignore secrets and config files
appsettings.Development.json
secrets.json
.env

# Ignore Rider / JetBrains files
.idea/
*.sln.iml

# Ignore Publish artifacts
publish/
out/

# Ignore ReSharper files
*.DotSettings.user
